## Environment

Include the repository revision, PHP version, OS and command or dashboard view.

## Expected and actual behavior

Share steps using synthetic data. Include sanitized output and any state, transition or depth limits.

## Regression

If known, give the last revision where the behavior worked.

For sensitive implementation issues, use the repository security policy and private reporting channel.
